name: SAP Azure SRE Agent Skills
description: 15 SRE skills for SAP HANA and NetWeaver workloads on Azure. Organized across 4 operational tiers: Observe, Diagnose, Prevent, Heal. Includes secure proxy functions for SAP VM command execution and configuration collection.
author: Microsoft SAP SRE

plugins.name: SAP Landscape Discovery
plugins.description: Discovers SAP system inventory across SIDs, roles, hosts, regions, VM sizes, zones, HA/DR topology, and monitoring coverage. Foundation data for all other skills.

plugins.name: SAP Deployment Readiness
plugins.description: Pre-flight validation for SAP VM deployments. Checks SKU availability, zone support, quota, restrictions, and SAP/HANA certification against SAP Notes.

plugins.name: SAP Operational Health
plugins.description: Unified health dashboard. Checks AMS provider health, data freshness, VM power state, CPU/memory/disk metrics, accelerated networking, Resource Health, and alert coverage.

plugins.name: SAP Performance Diagnostics
plugins.description: Diagnoses performance issues across HANA database, SAP application, and Azure storage layers. Covers memory pressure, blocking transactions, disk IOPS throttling, and savepoint duration.

plugins.name: SAP Resiliency Assessment
plugins.description: Evaluates SAP workload resiliency: availability zone coverage, HA architecture, load balancer redundancy, single points of failure, and zone migration readiness.

plugins.name: SAP Cost Insights
plugins.description: Analyzes Azure costs for SAP systems. Per-system cost breakdown, RI coverage, deallocated VM savings, and agent operating cost.

plugins.name: SAP Incident RCA
plugins.description: Cross-layer root cause analysis. Correlates Azure infrastructure, Guest OS, Pacemaker, HANA, and SAP application evidence. Conditional ServiceNow and Grafana enrichment.

plugins.name: SAP Configuration Guardian
plugins.description: 59 configuration checks aligned with STAF across infrastructure, storage, OS/SAP parameters, and cluster. T1 mode: audit. T3 mode: detect drift, recommend fix, apply on approval.

plugins.name: SAP HA & DR Guardian
plugins.description: Unified HA and DR health. Evaluates Pacemaker cluster, HSR replication, takeover readiness, and failover forensics. T3 mode: alert on SFAIL/quorum loss with approval gate.

plugins.name: SAP Anomaly Forecaster
plugins.description: Trend analysis on HANA memory, disk, CPU, and replication lag. Projects resource exhaustion via linear regression. Sends approval card with recommended action.

plugins.name: SAP Maintenance Autopilot
plugins.description: Handles Azure scheduled maintenance autonomously. Graceful SAP shutdown, HSR takeover for HA systems, event acknowledgment, restart monitoring, and recovery validation.

plugins.name: SAP Self-Healing
plugins.description: Handles time-critical scenarios: log volume full, backup staleness, sysctl drift after reboots. Fixed allowlist of actions, rate-limited to 20 actions/day.

plugins.name: SAP Command Executor
plugins.description: Executes 14 allowlisted read-only commands on SAP VMs via secure command proxy. The only skill with proxy credentials. Used directly and invoked by other skills.

plugins.name: SAP ServiceNow Connector
plugins.description: Conditional ServiceNow REST API integration. Queries change records, incident history, KB articles. Creates/updates incidents with structured RCA data. Agent-internal only.

plugins.name: SAP APM Connector
plugins.description: Connects to Dynatrace, SAP Focus Run, or AppDynamics via Grafana for deep HANA telemetry. Enriches RCA and Anomaly Forecaster. Agent-internal only.
